body_es: Trunk-based development es un modelo donde todos los desarrolladores trabajan en ramas de corta vida que se fusionan frecuentemente con la rama principal (trunk). Minimiza ramas divergentes y problemas de integración. Requiere CI/CD robusto para validar cambios rápidamente. Los feature flags ocultan trabajo incompleto en producción. Este modelo es popular en empresas que priorizan despliegues frecuentes. Contrasta con GitFlow, siendo más ágil pero exigiendo mayor disciplina.
body_en: Trunk-based development is a model where all developers work on short-lived branches that frequently merge with the main branch (trunk). It minimizes divergent branches and integration issues. It requires robust CI/CD to validate changes quickly. Feature flags hide incomplete work in production. This model is popular in companies prioritizing frequent deployments. It contrasts with GitFlow, being more agile but requiring greater discipline.
example_code:
git checkout -b trunk-fix-button-style
# Make changes
git commit -m "Fix button styling on dashboard"
# Push and create pull request
git push origin trunk-fix-button-style
# After approval and merge
git checkout main
git pull origin main
git branch -d trunk-fix-button-style
